items.text: Weekly review: 15 builds checked against Game8 and Prydwen (Castorice to Gallagher); no changes needed
Item descriptions and character lore updated to version 4.6 (26 more items with descriptions).
Light cones: Baptism of Pure Thought moves up to second choice, ahead of Worrisome, Blissful
Main stats: Feet SPD → ATK%, Link Rope Energy Regeneration Rate → ATK%
First weekly review: 15 builds checked against Game8 and Prydwen (Acheron to Bronya); the other 14 already matched
Rebuilt from Game8: Pearl joins her main Elation team, Physical DMG sphere, CRIT DMG body and Scholar Lost in Erudition as the second relic set
New teams with Evanescia and a free-to-play team; Eagle of Twilight Line replaces Messenger Traversing Hackerspace
Acheron team now with Welt and Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, new follow-up and beginner teams, SPD Boots and Energy Rope
Teams with Silver Wolf LV.999 and Pearl, Wavestrider Captain and Rutilant Arena added
Elation team with Pearl and a generalist team with Archer; Sneering and Warrior Goddess of Sun and Thunder added
Elation team with Pearl, HP% or DEF% sphere and more light cones
HP% or DEF% sphere and rope, SPD first in substats, new free-to-play team
Now has teams: ATK, HP and beginner
Teams with Sparxie, Evanescia and Aventurine • Waveflair; Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal added
Team with Saber now uses Robin • Summeretto, new free-to-play and beginner teams
New teams with Robin • Summeretto and Sparkle, and with Welt and Mortenax Blade
Break build and teams added alongside the CRIT one
Full teams with Archer and as main damage dealer
All 15 builds added on 2 November reviewed against Game8 (Prydwen has no builds for these characters yet)
Checked against Game8's November 2026 overall tier list: no rank changes
Character pages now have a Lore tab with the in-game Character Archive: details, stories and voice actors.
Every skill has a level selector, with the real in-game caps and the extra levels from Eidolons.
Favorites and collection: mark characters and light cones, with Eidolons and Superimpositions, and filter the lists by them.
My Account: look up your in-game showcase by UID and compare your builds with the guides. No login needed.
New tools: Planner (materials and Credits to level up), Stat Calculator, Compare (up to three characters) and Team Builder.
The game data now updates by itself every Wednesday, and this page lists what changes each week.

Team Builder: suggested teams now come from every guide (picking Acheron also shows Mortenax Blade's teams with her), teams with everyone you picked come first, and it says so when no guide puts your picks together.
